meta.subject: L1D MSHR and tagaccess bug fixed

en.summary: This commit fixes three L1 cache-control qualification bugs: a held read-hit reply is no longer popped during response backpressure, MSHR primary allocation is gated by the actual dequeue fire, and held tag-hit waymasks are reused only when the held probe was truly a hit.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says L1D MSHR and tagaccess bugs are being fixed.
All touched files are core L1 cache control blocks: DCache, MSHR, and tag access.
Each one-line change adds a missing handshake or hit qualifier that affects real cache behavior.
disqualifiers: The commit bundles three small cache-control fixes rather than one isolated bug site.
evidence: DCache.scala adds coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready to readHit_st2.io.deq.ready, so a buffered hit reply is not consumed while the response queue is stalled.
L1MSHR.scala adds MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire() to the primary miss allocation condition before setting subentry_valid.
L1TagAccess.scala requires both cachehit_hold.io.deq.valid and cachehit_hold.io.deq.bits.hit before reusing the held waymask.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The shared bug class here is unqualified state advancement in cache control logic. Buffered response state should advance only when the downstream consumer accepts it, miss-tracking state should allocate only when the allocating pipeline stage actually fires, and held tag metadata should be reused only when the held result corresponds to a real hit. Removing those qualifiers corrupts cache bookkeeping without changing the nominal datapath.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A buffered reply is stalled, a miss allocation path is backpressured, or held tag metadata is valid but the held operation was not actually a hit.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Advance dequeue, allocation, or held-metadata reuse on raw valid conditions instead of on successful handshake or hit-qualified conditions.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop handshake-or-hit qualifier on state update
portability_notes: This bug class maps to caches that use small holding queues or pipeline registers around response replay, miss allocation, or tag-hit replay.
You can inject any one of the three missing qualifiers as an independent fault if the target DUT does not implement all three structures.
The common semantic error is consuming speculative or stale state too early.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify a cache-control state update that should occur only on dequeue fire, enqueue fire, or confirmed hit.
Remove the handshake or hit predicate from that update while keeping the surrounding state machine unchanged.
Prefer a replay/holding structure, MSHR allocation site, or held tag-hit reuse site because those directly match the source commit.
Verify that the injected bug affects bookkeeping rather than changing request decode or SRAM contents.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: read-hit hold queue ready qualification, MSHR primary subentry allocation, and held tag-hit waymask reuse
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds downstream-ready gating before popping held read-hit state, adds MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire() before allocating a primary subentry, and prevents a held non-hit record from overriding the current waymask selection.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Commit 7dfd682e adds coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready to readHit_st2.io.deq.ready, adds MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire() in L1MSHR allocation, and changes L1TagAccess waymask reuse to require cachehit_hold.io.deq.bits.hit.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Cache bookkeeping becomes inconsistent: a held hit reply may be lost, an MSHR slot may be allocated spuriously, or stale way metadata may be used during flush or replacement, leading to hangs or incorrect eviction/response behavior.
evidence_for_injection: Each changed line adds exactly one missing qualification term to an existing control update.
All three fixes sit on cache control paths that decide when internal state may be consumed or reused.
The edits do not add new functionality; they tighten when existing state transitions are allowed.
notes: Because the commit is multi-site, the cleanest reinjection is to choose one of the three qualifiers and reverse only that edit in the target DUT.
The MSHR allocation guard and response-hold guard are the most portable anchors.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了三个 L1 cache 控制资格判断错误：被保持的 read-hit 回复在响应回压时不再提前出队，MSHR 主分配现在受真实 dequeue fire 约束，而保持的 tag-hit waymask 只有在保持记录确实是 hit 时才会被复用。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是 L1D 的 MSHR 和 tagaccess bug。
所有被修改文件都是核心 L1 cache 控制模块：DCache、MSHR 和 tag access。
这三个一行改动都给真实 cache 行为补上了缺失的握手或 hit 条件。
disqualifiers: 该提交把三个小的 cache-control 修复打包在一起，而不是单一故障点。
evidence: DCache.scala 在 readHit_st2.io.deq.ready 上加入了 coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready，因此响应队列阻塞时不会提前消费缓冲的 hit 回复。
L1MSHR.scala 在设置 subentry_valid 前加入了 MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire()，限定只有真实分配发生时才创建 primary miss 子项。
L1TagAccess.scala 复用保持的 waymask 时，要求 cachehit_hold.io.deq.valid 与 cachehit_hold.io.deq.bits.hit 同时为真。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这里的共性错误是 cache 控制状态在没有充分资格判断时就前进。被缓冲的回复状态只有在下游真正接收时才能前进，miss 跟踪状态只有在分配流水级真实 fire 时才能建立，而保持的 tag 元数据只有在对应结果确实命中时才能复用。去掉这些资格判断不会改变名义数据通路，却会破坏 cache 内部记账。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 缓冲回复被阻塞、miss 分配路径回压，或者保持的 tag 元数据虽然 valid 但对应操作并不是真实命中。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 dequeue、allocation 或保持元数据复用仅依据 raw valid 前进，而不再依据真实握手或命中条件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop handshake-or-hit qualifier on state update
portability_notes: 该类故障适用于在回复重放、miss 分配或 tag-hit 重放周围使用小保持队列或流水寄存器的 cache。
如果目标 DUT 没有完全相同的三个结构，可以只注入其中任意一个缺失资格条件，作为独立故障。
其共同语义错误是过早消费了推测性或陈旧状态。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到一个本应只在 dequeue fire、enqueue fire 或确认 hit 时才更新的 cache-control 状态。
在保持周围状态机不变的前提下，从该更新条件中删掉握手或 hit 谓词。
优先选择回复保持结构、MSHR 分配点或保持的 tag-hit 复用点，因为它们与源提交最直接对应。
确认注入后影响的是控制记账，而不是请求解码或 SRAM 内容本身。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: read-hit 保持队列的 ready 资格、MSHR 主子项分配，以及保持的 tag-hit waymask 复用
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在弹出保持的 read-hit 状态前增加了下游 ready 条件，在分配 primary subentry 前增加了 MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire()，并阻止保持的非 hit 记录覆盖当前 waymask 选择。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 提交 7dfd682e 分别在 DCache、L1MSHR 和 L1TagAccess 中补上了一个缺失的资格条件。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: cache 内部记账会变得不一致：保持的 hit 回复可能丢失，MSHR 槽位可能被错误分配，或者在 flush/replace 时使用了陈旧的 way 元数据，从而导致挂起或错误的替换与回复行为。
evidence_for_injection: 每一处改动都是在现有控制更新条件里补上一个缺失的资格项。
三处修复都位于决定内部状态何时可以被消费或复用的 cache 控制路径上。
这些修改没有增加新功能，只是收紧了已有状态转换允许发生的条件。
notes: 由于提交是多点修复，最干净的重新注入方式是在目标 DUT 上只反转其中一个资格判断。
其中 MSHR 分配保护和回复保持保护是最容易移植的锚点。
